method: Inspected all final pages rendered by Poppler at 125 dpi, including all five figures at their published size. Verified the opening URI and rectangle with PyMuPDF.
checks: Title followed by a visible, underlined link to the requested repository
Chinese text, charts, tables, captions and footers are legible without clipping or overlap
Four training histories have loss and accuracy panels and train/validation legends
Confusion matrix axes and all ten class rows are readable
Error examples and Grad-CAM labels match the accompanying discussion
All pages are numbered in order and Chinese font subsets are embedded
